notes: Vocabulary for visit_outcomes.metric_name / metric_category (schema.sql). CG6 of docs/CLINICAL_GRAPH_TRACK.md. Ids are opaque and immutable (DECISIONS D1) — add, never rename. Deliberately NOT here: 舌象 and 脈象 live on visits.tongue_* / pulse_* and soap_notes.objective_* (CG7 — one fact, one home); 疼痛 maps to metric.pain_score and 疲勞 maps to metric.energy_level rather than getting duplicate metrics.

records.name: pain_score
records.label_zh: 疼痛(0 無痛 / 10 最痛)
records.interpretation_en: A decrease of about 2 points, or roughly 30%, on the 0–10 scale is commonly cited as the threshold for a clinically meaningful improvement in pain intensity.

source.name: Farrar JT, Young JP Jr, LaMoreaux L, Werth JL, Poole RM. Clinical importance of changes in chronic pain intensity measured on an 11-point numerical pain rating scale. Pain. 2001;94(2):149-158.

records.patient_prompt_zh: 疼痛:過去24小時平均痛多少?0=不痛,10=最痛
records.patient_prompt_en: Pain: On average over the last 24 hours, how bad was your pain? 0 = no pain, 10 = worst pain.

records.name: sleep_quality
records.label_zh: 睡眠品質(0 最差 / 10 最好)
records.patient_prompt_zh: 睡眠品質:整體來說,這幾天睡得好嗎?0=非常差,10=非常好
records.patient_prompt_en: Sleep quality: Overall, how well have you been sleeping these past few days? 0 = very poor, 10 = very good.

records.name: sleep_hours
records.patient_prompt_zh: 睡眠時數:平均一晚睡幾小時?
records.patient_prompt_en: Sleep hours: On average, how many hours do you sleep per night?

records.name: sleep_onset_minutes
records.instrument_en: self-reported sleep diary (e.g. Consensus Sleep Diary core item: sleep onset latency)

source.name: Carney CE, Buysse DJ, Ancoli-Israel S, Edinger JD, Krystal AD, Lichstein KL, Morin CM. The consensus sleep diary: standardizing prospective sleep self-monitoring. Sleep. 2012;35(2):287-302.

records.patient_prompt_zh: 入睡時間:躺下後大約幾分鐘才睡著?
records.patient_prompt_en: Sleep onset: About how many minutes does it take you to fall asleep after lying down?

records.name: night_wakings
records.instrument_en: self-reported sleep diary (e.g. Consensus Sleep Diary core item: number of awakenings)

source.name: Carney CE, Buysse DJ, Ancoli-Israel S, Edinger JD, Krystal AD, Lichstein KL, Morin CM. The consensus sleep diary: standardizing prospective sleep self-monitoring. Sleep. 2012;35(2):287-302.

records.patient_prompt_zh: 夜醒次數:一個晚上大概醒來幾次?
records.patient_prompt_en: Night wakings: About how many times do you wake up during the night?

records.name: stress_level
records.patient_prompt_zh: 壓力:最近感覺壓力有多大?0=完全沒有,10=壓力最大
records.patient_prompt_en: Stress: How much stress have you been feeling lately? 0 = none at all, 10 = the most stress possible.

records.name: mood
records.label_zh: 情緒(0 最差 / 10 最好)。與 stress_level 分開:壓力是外在負荷,情緒是主觀狀態
records.label_en: Mood (0 worst / 10 best). Kept separate from stress_level: stress is external load, mood is subjective state
records.patient_prompt_zh: 情緒:最近整體情緒如何?0=非常差,10=非常好
records.patient_prompt_en: Mood: How has your overall mood been lately? 0 = very poor, 10 = very good.

records.name: energy_level
records.label_zh: 精神體力(0 最差 / 10 最好)。疲勞記在這一項的低分,不另開 fatigue metric
records.label_en: Energy level (0 worst / 10 best). Fatigue is recorded as a low value here rather than as a separate fatigue metric
records.patient_prompt_zh: 精神體力:最近精神體力如何?0=非常差(很累),10=非常好(有活力)
records.patient_prompt_en: Energy: How has your energy level been lately? 0 = very poor (exhausted), 10 = very good (energetic).

records.name: bloating
records.patient_prompt_zh: 腹脹:最近腹脹的程度如何?0=完全不脹,10=脹到最嚴重
records.patient_prompt_en: Bloating: How bad has your bloating been lately? 0 = not at all, 10 = worst possible.

records.name: bowel_frequency
records.patient_prompt_zh: 排便頻率:過去一週大概排便幾次?
records.patient_prompt_en: Bowel movements: About how many times did you have a bowel movement in the past week?

records.name: cycle_length
records.patient_prompt_zh: 月經週期:上次月經到這次月經開始,間隔大約幾天?
records.patient_prompt_en: Cycle length: About how many days from the start of your last period to the start of this one?

records.name: bleeding_days
records.patient_prompt_zh: 經期天數:這次月經流血總共持續幾天?
records.patient_prompt_en: Bleeding days: How many days did the bleeding last this cycle?

records.name: menstrual_flow_volume
records.patient_prompt_zh: 月經量:這次月經量偏少、正常、還是偏多?
records.patient_prompt_en: Flow volume: Was your flow this cycle scanty, normal, or heavy?

records.name: menstrual_clots
records.patient_prompt_zh: 血塊:這次月經有血塊嗎?沒有/小血塊/大血塊?
records.patient_prompt_en: Clots: Did you have blood clots this cycle? None / small / large?

records.name: ovulation_confirmed
records.patient_prompt_zh: 排卵確認:這個週期有確認排卵嗎?有/沒有/不確定
records.patient_prompt_en: Ovulation: Did you confirm ovulation this cycle? Yes / no / not sure.

records.name: lh_surge
records.patient_prompt_zh: LH 試紙:這個週期驗到 LH 陽性(排卵)了嗎?陽性/陰性/不確定
records.patient_prompt_en: LH surge test: Did you get a positive LH (ovulation) test strip this cycle? Positive / negative / not sure.

records.name: basal_body_temperature_pattern
records.instrument_en: basal body temperature (BBT) charting, oral thermometer taken immediately on waking
records.patient_prompt_zh: 基礎體溫:這個週期的基礎體溫型態如何(例如是否有明顯升溫)?請簡述
records.patient_prompt_en: Basal body temperature: What did your BBT pattern look like this cycle (e.g. a clear rise)? Brief description.

records.name: post_treatment_reaction
records.label_zh: 治療後反應(針後痠脹、疲倦、好轉反應等)。安全性事件記 adverse_reaction,不記這裡
records.label_en: Post-treatment reaction (post-needling soreness, tiredness, healing reaction). Safety events go to adverse_reaction, not here
records.patient_prompt_zh: 治療後反應:上次針灸後有什麼感覺或反應嗎?(痠脹、疲倦、變好等)
records.patient_prompt_en: Post-treatment reaction: Did you notice anything after your last treatment (soreness, tiredness, feeling better, etc.)?

records.name: effect_duration_days
records.label_zh: 效果維持時間(天)。決定療程間隔的依據
records.label_en: Effect duration in days. The basis for setting treatment intervals
records.patient_prompt_zh: 效果維持:上次治療的效果大概維持了幾天?
records.patient_prompt_en: Effect duration: About how many days did the effect from your last treatment last?

records.name: adverse_reaction
records.patient_prompt_zh: 不良反應:治療後有任何不舒服或異常反應嗎?請說明
records.patient_prompt_en: Adverse reaction: Did you have any discomfort or unusual reaction after treatment? Please describe.

records.name: fatigue_score
records.patient_prompt_zh: 疲勞:最近整體疲勞程度如何?0=完全不累,10=累到極點
records.patient_prompt_en: Fatigue: How fatigued have you felt lately overall? 0 = not tired at all, 10 = extremely fatigued.

records.name: stool_form_bristol
records.interpretation_en: Types 3–4 are generally regarded as the typical/formed range; because both harder (constipation-type) and looser (diarrhea-type) extremes can be clinically relevant, direction is deliberately 'range' rather than higher or lower being better.

source.name: Lewis SJ, Heaton KW. Stool form scale as a useful guide to intestinal transit time. Scand J Gastroenterol. 1997;32(9):920-924.

records.patient_prompt_zh: 糞便型態:最近的糞便比較接近 Bristol 分類的第幾型(1顆粒狀最硬,7水狀最軟)?
records.patient_prompt_en: Stool form: Which Bristol type does your stool most resemble lately (1 = hard lumps, 7 = watery)?

records.name: hot_flash_count_day
records.instrument_en: daily hot flash / vasomotor symptom diary (episode count)
records.patient_prompt_zh: 潮熱次數:最近平均一天發作幾次潮熱?
records.patient_prompt_en: Hot flashes: On average, how many hot flash episodes do you have per day?

records.name: range_of_motion_deg
records.interpretation_en: Normal range of motion is joint- and movement-specific (e.g. shoulder abduction vs. knee flexion), so a change in degrees should be interpreted against that specific joint/movement's own expected range rather than one universal threshold.
